name: E3_scan10_TEMPLATE
notes: #102 characterization E3: 10-min all-camera 40Hz laser-on scan from a CONTROLLED start temperature. COPY this directory per trial (E3_scan10_start35, E3_scan10_start60, ...), set name to match, and gate the start with thermal_logger --exit-below <T> (cooling) or --exit-above <T> (preheating via a short scan). Outputs land next to the manifest, so each trial needs its own copy. PASS = all 16 cameras deliver frames for the full 600 s (deaths.py reports zero died/never_started rows).
